subject: PoC deployment options & proposed trial playbook
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@aurorahealthtech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC deployment options & proposed trial playbook

Hi Dana / Michael —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before we draft an SOW:

What we covered
- Workload: clinical notes ingestion + patient-facing summaries (near real-time; avg doc size ~300 tokens)
- Primary concerns: throughput predictability for peak hours, PHI handling / HIPAA controls, and data residency within the US
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API, Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool), Private (VPC / on-prem)

Where you landed on the call
- Priority: predictable latency during daytime peaks (Dedicated favored)
- Security: must support HIPAA controls + audit logs; Private is acceptable but would require longer lead time

Proposed PoC approach (draft)
1) Mode: Dedicated capacity trial (2-week technical trial, followed by a 6-week ramp period)
2) Success criteria (we'll refine with your security & infra teams):
   - 99th percentile latency <= 250ms for 512-token inference
   - Sustained throughput target: 6 reqs/sec with autoscale headroom to 12 reqs/sec
   - Verified audit logging and token-level retention policy consistent with Aurora's data retention policy
   - Functional correctness on a seed test set (F1 / ROUGE checks we define together)
3) Timeline: kickoff next week, trial start within 7 days of kickoff, wrap and review within 21 days
4) Stakeholders we expect to engage: product owner (Dana), infra/security (Michael), procurement (legal contact), Redwood AE + Solutions Engineer + Security SME

Attachments: I attached a short trial-checklist and a first-pass PoC SOW (Aurora-PoC-SOW-v1.pdf) for your review.

Action items for Aurora
- Confirm preferred mode (if Dedicated still preferred) and who from infra/security should be on the kickoff
- Share any hard constraints on residency/IP allowlisting

I can update the SOW with your names for stakeholders and a more precise timeline once you confirm.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@aurorahealthtech.com>

Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aurorahealthtech.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC deployment options & proposed trial playbook

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. We reviewed this internally and I wanted to confirm a few items and add detail on our side.

Quick answers:
- Preferred mode: Dedicated capacity. Predictable throughput and fewer operational changes for our infra team is the highest priority.
- Residency: All data must remain within US regions; no cross-border backups.
- Compliance: We require HIPAA controls (audit logging, KMS integration) — if Redwood already has a standard HIPAA attestation flow that would be great.

Success criteria (Aurora view) — please add into the SOW:
- Latency: p99 <= 300ms under a sustained 8 reqs/sec workload (during peak simulated window)
- Throughput: sustained 8 reqs/sec; spike-handling to 15 reqs/sec for short bursts
- Security: KMS integration for key management + proof of audit log sampling for 7 days of activity
- Accuracy: pass on our clinical QA set (we'll send test vectors)

Stakeholders that will join kickoff:
- Dana Reynolds, Product Owner (clinical summaries)
- Michael Chen, Infrastructure Lead (network + firewall rules)
- Priya Shah, Security Officer (HIPAA & compliance) — I'll loop her in after initial scheduling
- Procurement contact: lisa.kim@aurorahealthtech.com

We'd like a kickoff next week (March 8 or 9) if that works. I'll upload a network diagram and our minimal allowlist once we confirm the date.

Thanks — looking forward to the trial.
Dana
VP of Product | Aurora HealthTech
Dana.Reynolds@aurorahealthtech.com

Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PoC deployment options & proposed trial playbook

Dana / Michael —

Great — Dedicated capacity it is. I've updated the SOW with Aurora's requested success criteria and residency note; attaching v1.1 in the repo. High-level next steps below so everyone has visibility:

1) Kickoff meeting: proposed Mon Mar 8, 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes (agenda: confirm test vectors, allowlist steps, and trial monitoring dashboards). Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/vanessa/aurora-kickoff
2) Pre-kickoff deliverables (Aurora): network diagram, allowlist, initial QA/test vector sample (Priya for security to review)
3) Redwood deliverables pre-trial: Dedicated capacity config proposal, pricing estimate, temporary HIPAA attestation checklist, trial monitoring dashboard access
4) Trial window: 2 weeks (technical validation) starting within 48 hours of provisioning, followed by 2-week ramp/observation if criteria met

Rishi — can you confirm the capacity profile (GPU / vCPU targets) and a provisional pricing band for a 2-week Dedicated trial + 6-week ramp? Also confirm the provisioning lead time so we can lock the kickoff date.

If procurement needs a starter contract or an MSA redline, I can loop in our contracts team; otherwise, we can run the initial technical trial under a short-form SOW.

Thanks all — I'll update the SOW link after Rishi confirms pricing.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Dana —

Quick update on capacity and pricing for the Dedicated trial:

Recommended config for target workload (sustained 8 reqs/sec, peaks to 15):
- Dedicated pool: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs with an autoscale headroom policy to add 1 GPU for spikes
- Expected provisioning lead time: 3 business days once SOW is signed + account details provided

Pricing (provisional, for trial only):
- 2-week technical trial: $9,500 (flat trial fee covering reserved capacity + monitoring access)
- 6-week ramp (optional, billed monthly after trial): estimated $32,000 / month (committed reserved capacity pricing)

Compliance and security notes:
- We can provide KMS integration and audit log sampling for the trial window. For full HIPAA attestation we will engage Security for an SOC/HIPAA packet (2–3 weeks) — we can run the technical trial in parallel with that review if Aurora is comfortable.

Action: Vanessa — if Aurora confirms kickoff March 8, I need procurement contact (lisa.kim@aurorahealthtech.com) to initiate the simple SOW; accounting will prepare an invoice for the trial fee. Sergio will be the Solutions Engineer on the trial and will handle provisioning and dashboard access.
